obligations.requirement: RB-V01 compiles as an immutable Vector brush version with canonical-expressible live parameters and fixed/versioned taper semantics.
acceptance: existing v1 program identities/goldens remain unchanged
RB-V01 version is explicit and deterministic
size, pressure/thinning and smoothing changes alter expected program/geometry state
taper is not stored as a transient-only per-stroke parameter

obligations.requirement: Common Axiom vector geometry generation produces continuous filled variable-width geometry and supports incremental stable-prefix / replaceable-tail evaluation.
acceptance: output is not one primitive per raw sample and not a constant-width centerline
one-shot and chunked confirmed input converge within frozen numeric tolerance
stable prefix remains stable while the active tail may be replaced
fixed start/end taper is visible and deterministic

obligations.requirement: Canonical persistence/replay uses the existing StrokeRecord/BrushDescriptor schema and can regenerate RB-V01 semantics.
acceptance: no canonical schema change
brush version is preserved in canonical descriptor
pressure/thinning is faithfully represented through the existing pressure curve contract
smoothing is faithfully persisted
replay regenerates equivalent stable vector geometry

obligations.requirement: Axiom canonical Skia rendering consumes common vector geometry semantics rather than the existing fixed 3 px path approximation.
acceptance: pressure/width variation affects raster output
fixed taper affects raster output
same canonical fixture produces stable geometry/raster digest
existing legacy render tests remain green

obligations.requirement: Windows Arc preview consumes Axiom-produced render-ready vector geometry and does not reconstruct freehand semantics from raw pointer samples.
acceptance: raw pointer -> appendPreviewSamples fixed-radius shortcut is not the qualification path
Arc preview payload is derived from common vector geometry
Arc owns raster/presentation only
preview stable geometry digest matches the common semantic output

obligations.requirement: Space dual-color diagnostic changes presentation color only.
acceptance: Arc and canonical colors are visibly distinct when diagnostic is ON
program identity, vector geometry digest and canonical brush data are unchanged
legacy runtime-preview mirror no longer owns Space if retained

obligations.requirement: Preview -> CanonicalCommitted -> CanonicalVisible -> Arc clear remains token/generation safe with no material geometry pop.
acceptance: wrong/stale token cannot clear current preview
Arc clear occurs only after eligible canonical presentation evidence
handoff parity detects path/width/taper discontinuity

obligations.requirement: Vector-heavy workload metrics are exported for G5 without implementing G5 optimization.
acceptance: captures input samples, geometry vertex/point counts, tail replacements, BrushRuntime CPU time, preview submit bytes and handoff timing
no Tile/SpatialIndex/Scheduler/ResourceBudget implementation is introduced

obligations.requirement: Portable and historical regressions remain green and exact Windows qualification artifacts are reviewer-resolvable.
obligations.oracle: G4/G4.4/G4.5 CTest + G4.5 Programmable Brush Qualification + Arc/POC-06 exact-result verification
acceptance: relevant Windows/Web/Android builds/tests pass
Arc/POC-06 passes
no forbidden diff
exact Windows qualification bundle is bound to the result revision

expected_failures: BrushRuntime vector path currently emits one BrushPrimitive per input sample instead of a freehand filled geometry stream.
SkiaInkBackend canonical submit currently renders a fixed 3 px stroked path.
Windows appendPreviewSamples currently maps raw pointer samples directly to fixed-radius ARC_PREVIEW_PRIMITIVE_VECTOR_POINT values.
Space currently toggles the legacy runtime preview mirror rather than the dual-color semantic-neutral diagnostic.
oracle_precondition.observation_seam: runtime/ink vector compiler/runtime + runtime/render Skia canonical path + Windows Arc preview integration
